text:
You need help setting up and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns to increase sales through stronger keyword targeting and data-driven campaign decisions.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery model joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of ad budget being reallocated and a 12% drop in customer acquisition cost the next quarter.

I’d bring the same structured analysis to your Amazon PPC setup: keyword research, performance monitoring, and clear optimization recommendations based on campaign data. If you want, I can help turn campaign data into practical actions that support sales growth.
